All nine published primary AV applications are navigable from the Rail (#312) at c77b0cd. Source deployment 37893934453 and AV destination deployment 37895712977 passed; production source.json, nine live Console links, zero Planned entries, Audio launch and ten AV Video page-asset matches were verified. Physical/operator and connected-workflow acceptance remain separate.

In-console application snapshots (#314, publication repairs #317/#316) are published at 9c370be. All eight non-Video Rail applications open within AV Video as selectable, resizable and reconfigurable panels; stored arrangements, Change/Close state, focus, standalone routes and independent app data passed isolated live production checks on Walter.
